user.title: Set up pellet prices
user.description:
Which country's market prices do you want to track?

Prices come from heizpellets24 (heizpellets24.de, .at or .ch) and include VAT and delivery. The source quotes them for a total order of 6,000 kg. Swiss prices are in CHF.

data_description.land: Determines both the choices in the next step and the currency of the sensors.

region.title: Choose a region

data_description.region: Federal states also provide a bagged-goods price; the country level provides three-year figures instead. For Switzerland the source carries no regional prices — only the national average.
data_description.menge: Only used to extrapolate the total price. It does not change the market price per tonne.
data_description.einblaspauschale: What your supplier charges per delivery for blowing the pellets in. It is added to the bulk total price only — the source quotes its prices "plus blow-in fee" without naming an amount. Leave at 0 to ignore it.

abort.already_configured: This region is already set up.

init.title: Adjust pellet prices

data_description.menge: Only used to extrapolate the total price. It does not change the market price per tonne.
data_description.einblaspauschale: Surcharge per delivery, bulk goods only. Bagged pellets are delivered on pallets and are not blown in.
data_description.bundesland_vergleich: Adds two sensors for the cheapest and the most expensive federal state. Only in the country-level entry, and only where the source carries federal states.

extremwerte_zuruecksetzen.name: Reset observed extremes
extremwerte_zuruecksetzen.description: Discards the recorded lowest or highest price of the targeted sensors; recording restarts from the current price. Only applies to the sensors marked "(observed)".
